title: 男の子と女の子の全身
subject_en: Full-body children (a boy and a girl alternately), loose hand-drawn style with simple faces, one child per cell, whole body visible from head to shoes, casual clothes Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 走る・座る・手を振るなど、子どもの全身のポーズ12点の素材です。園だよりや学校の資料、絵本風の挿し絵に使えます。

a girl running with a ponytail flying
a boy standing and waving one hand
a girl standing and waving one hand
a boy sitting cross-legged on the floor
a girl sitting with knees hugged
